shared_elements: small human or humanoid figure with raised/bent limbs
figures arranged in loose horizontal tiers across a rectangular field
repeated small marks forming a band-like grouping
justification: Both surfaces spread small figures across a broadly rectangular field in loose horizontal registers, and each includes at least one schematic humanoid with bent, raised limbs plus isolated disc/dot motifs. Otherwise they diverge completely: A is a flat, high-contrast painted silhouette scene dominated by crowded, dynamic human bodies, whereas B is a low-relief carving in stone with sparse, static animal forms and a formal zigzag band, so the manner of rendering and the subject emphasis share nothing specific.
